about_the_game:
Eliond is a world devastated by mutation and war. Cities have collapsed, creatures have transformed, and the actions of Dr. Victor Madman continue to spread corruption across the land.

The Cryselts, an elite task force dedicated to protecting the planet, work to contain the crisis and rebuild what remains. Explore diverse regions, battle hostile enemies, and unlock new weapons, abilities, and Biosuit upgrades as you progress through interconnected areas.

Your journey includes rescuing survivors, discovering hidden technology, completing missions, and restoring key parts of the ruined civilization. Each upgrade and discovery expands your mobility and combat options, opening new paths and challenges throughout Eliond.

Features

Combat & Weapons

  • Engage in fast and tactical combat using powerful ranged weapons and a special melee knife.

  • Defeat deadly enemies, mini-bosses, and massive bosses that guard key areas.

  • Unlock alternate weapon modes and upgrade your arsenal.

Exploration

  • Explore a vast interconnected world filled with hidden paths and environmental secrets.

  • Use specialized suits, modules, and abilities to access new regions.

  • Navigate between safe and hazardous zones as you uncover lost technology.

Character Development

  • Customize your build by equipping different Biosuits, each with unique properties.

  • Collect modules and upgrades to enhance your abilities and stats.

  • Manage Energy (EN) and Nanites to survive combat and exploration.

Narrative & Choice

  • Interact with a deep cast of unique NPCs, each with personal stories and missions.

  • Encounter allies whose relationships and choices influence the course of your journey.

  • Witness changing dialogue and character behavior as the story progresses.

World Progression

  • Rebuild the City Ruins — restore homes, attract survivors, and unlock new side content.

  • Collect energy cells to reactivate the ancient portal to send you back home.

  • Shape the world’s recovery with your decisions and actions.

Special Systems

  • Serina AI — your suit’s onboard assistant, offering navigation, analysis, and guidance.

Economy & Crafting

  • Gather RES (resources) to trade with merchants or fund reconstruction efforts.

  • Discover rare materials to craft powerful suits, each granting new gameplay effects.

B3N Games Studio

B3N Games Studio is an independent game developer passionate about creating immersive, story-driven experiences. Combining modern pixel-art visuals with deep gameplay systems, we craft worlds full of adventure, challenge, and discovery. At B3N, every game is a journey designed to captivate players and push the boundaries of 2D gaming.

short_description: Cryselts is a 2D pixel-art Metroidvania focused on exploration, modular suits, and ranged combat, set in a hostile world corrupted by a mutagenic threat. Join the Cryselts, an elite task force designed to protect the planet.
